scope: Additive Magic Mirror L1-27 and Queen clone audit of summon, one-second invisibility and Equipment-bonus exclusions.
game_version: Official 2024-08 release and 2024-09 clone fixes; claimed client build 18.600.3 for dated 2026 Hero HP table; version unstated for independent clone table; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Anime Medal Event & New Hero Equipment!
facts: Magic Mirror is permanent Epic Archer Queen Equipment introduced during the time-limited Anime Medal Event.
It summons Queen clones with a portion of her HP and damage for a limited duration; the original Queen is initially invisible for one second after use.
sources.limitations: The article does not give clone count/HP/DPS by level, spawn position, target AI or invisibility target-loss timing. The event troop is excluded from this goal.

sources.title: September Update: Full Patch Notes
facts: Magic Mirror clones no longer receive damage boosts from Invisibility Vial or any Equipment.
Clones no longer receive passive Equipment DPS buffs and no longer affect Archer Queen re-deployment time.
sources.limitations: The patch does not define cloning base HP/DPS arithmetic, other auras, Pet pairing, clone disappearance phase or combat target order.

sources.title: Magic Mirror — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The public per-level Queen HP and cost table matches the pinned payload, including L27 HP 861.
sources.limitations: The public table omits clone count, DPS, HP, duration and Queen recovery.

sources.title: Magic Mirror
facts: The public per-level clone count, duration, DPS, HP, Queen HP and recovery table matches the pinned raw payload; L27 lists two clones, 30 seconds, 765 DPS and 3216 HP.
sources.limitations: The page gives no publication date, client build or clone behavior and tick order.

sources.title: Pinned Magic Mirror Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: The pinned 27 rows preserve clones, cloneDuration, cloneDps, cloneHealth, Queen HP and recovery; the ability field gives one-second Queen invisibility.
sources.limitations: The payload does not define clone stat derivation, attack cadence, spawn placement or current effect continuity.

observations.note: All raw effect fields match the independent version-unknown table; current-build continuity remains unverified.
Only official exclusion constraints are established; no clone actor or attack AI is inferred.

derivations.result: Retain clone count, HP, DPS, duration and Queen recovery as data-only
derivations.method: Cross-check all 27 pinned raw rows against the independent version-unknown public table; do not assert current-build continuity.

derivations.result: Exclude Equipment damage and passive DPS buffs from clones if implemented
derivations.method: Apply only the official 2024 bug-fix constraints; do not infer other status-effect or aura inheritance.

rejected_inferences.rule: Give clone actors the original Queen's Equipment bonuses or Invisibility Vial damage
rejected_inferences.reason: Supercell explicitly removed these damage and passive DPS boosts.

rejected_inferences.rule: Calculate clone HP and DPS as a fixed percentage of Queen values
rejected_inferences.reason: The launch description is qualitative and pinned per-level clone fields are explicit; no current percentage or rounding is published.

rejected_inferences.rule: Make clones invisible for the original Queen's one-second invisibility interval
rejected_inferences.reason: The release text attributes initial invisibility to the Archer Queen, not expressly to the clones.

rejected_inferences.rule: Spawn clones at fixed offsets and give them inherited Queen target state
rejected_inferences.reason: Spawn geometry, collision, target selection and entity-ID order are undocumented.

rejected_inferences.rule: Remove clones exactly 20, 25 or 30 seconds after activation before the final attack
rejected_inferences.reason: Duration is recorded, but spawn tick and expiry phase are not published.

items: current clone count/HP/DPS/duration and Queen recovery continuity
activation, clone spawn and Queen invisibility tick order
Queen target loss and projectile interaction during one-second invisibility
Queen HP/recovery cap and simultaneous Equipment order
Viewer clone/invisibility art, snapshot, replay and RL activation
clone stat derivation and ordinary Queen level/mode relationship
spawn location, collision, ID and simultaneous clone order
attack cadence, projectile speed, targeting and death/expiry phase
damage immunity, traps, Pets, auras and spell status effects
Equipment exclusion staging with other modifiers

conclusion: Magic Mirror L1-27 and Queen clones remain partial and catalogue-only. Official sources establish the clone summon, one-second original-Queen invisibility and Equipment-bonus exclusions, but current clone effects and deterministic spawn, combat and expiry ordering are incomplete.
